For our client in the Kortrijk region, we are looking for a motivated Carpet Finishing Operator to strengthen our team on the finishing line.

 

• Cutting and finishing carpets to size

• Processing carpets on the finishing line

• Carrying out quality checks

• Attaching fringes when necessary

• Applying labels to carpets

• Ensuring a neat and high-quality finish

Job Requirements:

• You are precise and enjoy working with your hands

• You have an eye for quality and attention to detail

• You can work independently, but you are also a team player

• Experience in carpets, textiles or garment manufacturing is a plus

• Experience is not required: motivation and a positive work attitude are important

• You speak Dutch, French or English

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Packaging Supervisor to join the  team on the night shift. 

Your responsibilities:

• Supervise and coordinate the packaging team during the night shift.

• Ensure that packaging activities are carried out efficiently and according to production planning.

• Follow and maintain the work schedule

• Lead and coordinate team members

• Actively contribute to the work on the floor

• Work responsibly, flexibly, and independently

 

 

Requirements:

• Previous experience in a packaging, production, or supervisory role.

• Strong organizational and leadership skills.

• Ability to work independently and make decisions under pressure.

• Willingness to work night shifts.

• Experience in a food production or manufacturing environment is an advantage.

• Good command of English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

As a Recruitment Consultant, you'll play a key role in connecting top talent with the right opportunities. You'll manage the full recruitment cycle, from sourcing and interviewing candidates, to advising clients and closing successful placements.

Client Details

You will be joining a small division of a global player in the field of recruitment, which has also won the Top Employer award several times in a row and located in the hearth of Brussels.

Description

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Building and maintaining strong relationships with both clients and candidates

• 
Managing recruitment processes from A to Z

• 
Advising clients on market trends, salary benchmarks and hiring strategies

• 
Actively sourcing talent through various channels and conducting interviews

• 
Collaborating with a high-performing team in a supportive and ambitious environment

We are looking for a (Junior) Recruitment Consultant that :

• 
You speak French and English fluently (Dutch is a strong plus)

• 
You have a strong sense of initiative, and you thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment

• 
You enjoy building relationships and helping others succeed

• 
A first experience in sales, recruitment, or a customer-facing role is a plus - but not a must!

• 
You are motivated, resilient, and eager to grow both personally and professionally

We are currently looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist, fluent in French and English, to join a team based in Brussels.

In this temporary assignment, you will play a key role in supporting the full recruitment cycle within the professional services sector. Your responsibilities will include sourcing talent, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and ensuring an efficient and positive hiring process.

Client Details

A professional services organisation based in Brussels.

Description

As a recruiter your responsibilities are:

 

• Source and attract candidates using various recruitment channels.
• Screen and shortlist applicants based on job requirements.
• Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers.
• Maintain and update recruitment databases and records.
• Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Provide support in contract preparation and onboarding processes.
• Collaborate with the HR team to meet recruitment goals.
• Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and procedures

• Bilingual in French and English (mandatory)
• Previous experience in recruitment is required
• Enjoys daily interaction with people while also appreciating administrative tasks
• Available immediately
• Temporary contract, with a potential opportunity for a permanent position

jobs.occupation: Sales Executive Benelux - Watches Industry (Dutch Native)
jobs.description:
Our client is a distinguished leader in the fine watch and luxury industry, renowned for craftsmanship and timeless excellence.They are now looking for a driven Sales Executive Benelux, capable of elevating their commercial network and fostering long-term relationships.

Jobomschrijving

The Sales Executive Benelux will have the following responsibilities :

• Manage and develop relationships with the brand distribution network across the Benelux region.
• Conduct regular visits to points of sale to ensure operational excellence, identify improvement opportunities, and implement corrective actions.
• Build strong partnerships with retailers and act as the main point of contact for the brands.
• Maintain and actively manage CRM systems, ensuring accurate reporting and customer data management.
• Oversee visual merchandising standards to guarantee optimal brand image, visibility, and in-store presentation.
• Organize and deliver commercial training sessions for sales teams, focusing on product knowledge, sales techniques, and customer experience.
• Stay up to date with new product launches, brand developments, and watch market trends to effectively support and coach retail partners.

• First relevant experience in Retail or a Field Sales experience is expected
• Strong affinity for the watches industry
• Presentation and communication skills
• Client-driven, sense of service, attention to details
• Analytical skills
• Dutch native, Fluent in French and English

Working at Michael Page means joining an entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and performance-driven environment where consultants are empowered to develop their own client portfolio, advise businesses on talent strategies, and make a real impact on people's careers. The company promotes a culture of teamwork, integrity, meritocracy, and continuous career development.

Jobomschrijving

As a Recruitment Consultant your responsibilities are:

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients and candidates.
• Identify and source top talent through various recruitment methods.
• Manage the full recruitment cycle, from job briefing to offer negotiation.
• Provide expert advice to clients on market trends and hiring strategies.
• Screen, interview, and assess candidates for suitability.
• Ensure a high standard of service delivery to both clients and candidates.

A successful Recruitment Consultant should have:

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• An ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English and French OR Dutch.
• Passion for sales, recruitment, and business development
• A proactive mindset.

Joining our organization means becoming part of an international and dynamic retail environment.

Jobomschrijving

 People Strategy Develop and implement a comprehensive People & Culture strategy covering talent acquisition, talent development, succession planning, retention, and engagement.Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding Partner with recruitment teams to anticipate workforce needs, strengthen employer branding initiatives, and ensure an outstanding candidate experience.Culture & Employee Engagement Promote a strong organizational culture and implement initiatives that enhance employee engagement, well-being, and overall workplace experience.Learning & Development Drive learning strategies, identify development opportunities, and support employees and managers in achieving their full potential.Change Management & Communication Support organizational transformation projects, facilitate effective communication, and ensure alignment between business priorities and people initiatives.People Leadership Lead, coach, and develop the People team, fostering collaboration, accountability, empowerment, and high performance.People Analytics & Performance Track HR metrics and KPIs, analyze trends, and recommend data-driven actions that improve business performance and employee experience.

 You bring:

• Significant experience in Talent Management, Learning & Development, Organizational Development, or a strategic HR leadership role.
• Proven experience leading and developing teams.
• Experience within the retail or consumer-facing sector is an advantage.
• Strong communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.
• The ability to build trust and influence across all levels of an organization.
• Excellent organizational and analytical abilities, with a solution-oriented mindset.
• Adaptability and agility in fast-changing environments.
• Strong resilience and sound decision-making capabilities.
• A highly professional and people-centered approach, with a strong commitment to confidentiality.
• Fluency in at least two of the following languages: French, Dutch, and English.

Some people wait for opportunities.

Others create them.

We're looking for a Business Manager who thrives on opening new doors, building powerful client relationships, and turning business challenges into consulting solutions.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established Belgian consulting company with more than 15 years of success and a strong reputation in technology consulting. Over the last few years, the company has made a strategic shift towards one of the fastest-growing markets: Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning and AI Leadership.

Today, their challenge isn't finding talent.

It's finding enough clients for the exceptional consultants already in the business.

That's where you come in.

Description

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and growing a portfolio of clients across Brussels and Belgium.

From first contact to long-term partnership, you'll own the entire sales cycle.

You will:

• Identify and approach new clients
• Build relationships with decision-makers and executives
• Understand business challenges and propose the right consulting solution
• Sell AI expertise
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals
• Work closely with recruiters to match the right consultants to client needs
• Follow consultants on-site and ensure long-term client satisfaction
• Continuously expand your network and market knowledge
 

• You know how staffing and consulting work.
• You've already sold projects, consultants, services or expertise.
• You enjoy hunting for opportunities and building lasting commercial relationships.
• You probably have: 
• 2 to 6 years of experience in consulting, staffing, recruitment or IT services
• Experience developing new accounts from scratch
• A strong commercial mindset and entrepreneurial spirit
• The ability to challenge, influence and convince stakeholders
• Fluency in English, French and/or Dutch
• A passion for business development and people
• Most importantly: 
• You don't wait for leads.
• You create them.

Our client is a leading player in the financial services sector, known for its strong customer orientation, professional development opportunities, and collaborative culture. The company invests heavily in its employees and offers a stable environment where talent can grow and develop.

Jobomschrijving

• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers.
• Advise clients on products and services that match their needs.
• Support customers throughout their journey and provide excellent service.
• Identify commercial opportunities and contribute to business growth.
• Work closely with colleagues to ensure an outstanding customer experience.
• Participate in client meetings, follow-ups, and sales initiatives.

• Master's degree (field of study is not important).
• Fluent in French, Dutch, and English.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Commercial mindset with a genuine interest in sales and customer relationships.
• Proactive, dynamic, and eager to learn.
• Team player with a positive attitude.

Katoen Natie Gent is a logistics company specializing in the storage, transport, and handling of goods. The company is located in the city of Ghent in Belgium and has branches all over the world. Katoen Natie was founded in 1854 and has since grown into an international player in logistics and supply chain management.

Katoen Natie Gent is an important employer in the Ghent region and has a strong connection with the local community. The company has undertaken various initiatives in the past to support the local economy and has invested in sustainable logistics and innovation.

Jobomschrijving

For a warehouse specialized in motorcycles, we are looking for a technically skilled Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) & Assembly Associate. In this role, you are responsible for preparing, inspecting, and assembling motorcycles before they are delivered to the customer. You carry out precise quality checks, ensure correct assembly of components, and guarantee that each motorcycle meets the required quality standards.You will work in a two-shift system and join a dynamic environment where quality, safety, and teamwork are central.

Do you recognize yourself in the characteristics below? Then get in touch with us quickly!

You can easily understand and use English or Dutch in the workplace.

You are willing to work in a two-shift system.

You have a technical mindset and are comfortable working with tools.

You are flexible and able to handle stress.

You don’t shy away from Saturday work or occasional overtime.

You have a passion for motorcycles, machinery, or technology.

Experience in assembly, PDI, or a similar technical role is a plus.

For one of our clients, a company specialising in the petrochemical sector and located in the centre of Brussels, we are looking for a Customer Service Officer. 

As a Customer Service Officier you will be responsible for the management of daily operations in the Customer Service Department and work closely together with 2 Sales Representatives. In general he/she is the interface for the different services within the organization and will specialized for commercial and marketing topics.

Your responsibilities as a Customer Service Officer :

Customers :* Handle requests and claims from customers by phone and by email;* Contracts & files : check input, rebates & additional services contracts;* Follow-up marketing actions decided by the Benelux Country Manager;* Order of new customer cards and toll box;* Follow-up portfolio of customers;* Help train the customers to use autonomously extranet, customer portal etc.

General administration :* Mails (post) and the e-mails on the general mailbox;* Sales support for the sales representatives : invoice, edit credit notes, etc;* Reporting activities;* Back-up of colleagues (customer service, sales officer).

Network :* Administrative help to Technical Manager;* Manual acceptance authorization;* Follow up of fraud cases in stations;* Resolve and help customers on issues related to cards and tolls.

The ideal profile of a Customer Service Officer :* You have a perfect command of Dutch, both spoken and written. You also have a very good knowledge of French, both spoken and written. Knowledge of English is an asset.* You have initial experience in Customer Service, Customer Care or file management.* You have a good knowledge of IT tools (MS Office) and are familiar with CRM systems.* You are an organised person, you are willing to take initiative and you have good customer relations skills.* You can easily switch between different tasks and have strong communication skills.

With around 1,000 ‘Brabantians’, we are responsible for the worldwide production, marketing, sales and distribution of our Designed for Living products.

Brabantia has factories in Latvia, China and Belgium. At the Pelt site, we produce not only waste bins, but also bread bins and storage canisters. Adjacent to the production site is our distribution centre, from which Brabantia products are distributed worldwide.

More than 350 employees work at the Pelt site.

Jobomschrijving

Brabantia in Pelt is looking for Warehouse Operators!

Are you looking for a varied job in an international company? Then we are looking for you!

As a Warehouse Operator, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

• Manually picking orders
• Packing and labelling products
• Processing shipping documents
• Working with handheld scanners
You will also help keep the working environment clean and tidy. You always work safely and support your colleagues whenever needed.

As a Warehouse Operator at Brabantia, you will have a varied range of tasks.

• You are available to work in 2 shifts: from 5:30 AM to 2:00 PM and from 2:00 PM to 10:30 PM. On Fridays, the early shift is from 5:30 AM to 1:00 PM and the late shift from 1:00 PM to 8:30 PM
• You will work with handheld scanners and computer programs
• Experience with these tools or the motivation to learn how to use them is therefore essential
• You have experience operating an electric pallet truck or are willing to follow an internal training
• You have your own means of transportation, as Brabantia is not accessible by public transport
• You speak English fluently

To support continued growth, Our client are seeking an experienced Purchasing Manager to lead procurement activities, supplier strategy, and quality oversight across multiple European operations while managing a purchasing and quality team.

Jobomschrijving

As a Strategic Purchasing Manager your responsibilities are:

• Lead and develop the European purchasing function
• Manage and coach purchasing and quality teams
• Define and execute sourcing and supplier strategies
• Negotiate contracts, pricing and framework agreements
• Drive cost reduction initiatives and procurement performance
• Develop and monitor procurement KPIs
• Ensure material availability and inventory optimisation
• Partner closely with production, sales, logistics and quality teams

A successful Strategic Purchasing Manager should have:

• Minimum 10 years' experience in procurement within an industrial environment
• Proven people management experience
• Strong strategic sourcing and supplier management expertise
• Experience negotiating contracts and driving savings initiatives
• Familiarity with ERP systems and advanced Excel skills
• Fluent in English, Dutch and French
• Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills
• Results-driven, organised and resilient mindset

For a dynamic international company in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative who combines customer service with commercial flair and a technical interest. You enjoy working in a role where you interact daily with customers, the sales team and internal departments, and where you can make a real impact on business growth and customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will be the main commercial and customer-oriented point of contact for your region. Working closely with the External Sales Representative, you will build strong customer relationships and help expand the customer portfolio. You will manage a combination of new and existing customers, ensuring that everything runs smoothly and professionally, from quotations to follow-up.

Your responsibilities

• Acquiring new customers and further developing existing customer relationships.
• Growing existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling.
• Preparing and following up on quotations and price calculations.
• Processing orders and encouraging customers to use the E-Shop.
• Maintaining daily customer contact by phone and email, with a focus on commercial growth.
• Keeping customer information up to date in ERP/CRM systems.
• Identifying customer needs and commercial opportunities.
• Acting as the first point of contact for customer questions and support.
• Working closely with the External Sales Representative on reporting and follow-up.

• You have a strong hunter mentality and a clear commercial drive to win new customers.
• You have a commercial and/or technical background.
• You have experience in B2B sales, preferably in a technical environment.
• You are fluent in both spoken and written French and English.
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage but not a requirement.
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general IT tools.
• You have strong communication skills and a commercial mindset.

Are you looking for a job as a Payroll & Benefits Officer in Tienen? Combine payroll, benefits administration, HR support, and process improvement within an international organization. Ready to make an impact? Apply today!
 

As a Payroll & Benefits Officer, you play a key role within the HR team. You ensure employees receive accurate payroll processing and professional support regarding their benefits package. At the same time, you actively contribute to improving HR processes and systems.
 

This is a varied position where you combine administrative accuracy with employee interaction and collaboration with international colleagues.
 

As a Payroll & Benefits Officer, your responsibilities include:
 

 
• Managing payroll processing for employees in Belgium and gradually supporting payroll activities in other European countries.
 
• Administering a range of employee benefits, including company cars, insurance plans, pension schemes, and mobility solutions.
 
• Contributing to the optimization of payroll and HR processes and proactively identifying improvement opportunities.
 
• Ensuring the accurate registration and maintenance of employee data and HR records.
 
• Acting as the main point of contact for employees and managers regarding payroll and benefits-related questions. 
 

In addition, you work closely with payroll providers, insurance partners, and internal stakeholders. You also support reporting activities related to absenteeism, employee turnover, and other HR metrics.

 

For this Payroll & Benefits Officer position, we are looking for someone who enjoys working with figures, processes, and people. You are accurate, communicative, and thrive in an international environment.
 

You bring:
 

 
• A bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or equivalent experience.
 
• Experience in payroll, HR administration, or a similar role.
 
• An excellent command of English. Knowledge of Dutch, French, or other European languages is a strong asset.
 
• Solid MS Office skills. Experience with Workday and/or SD Worx is considered a plus.
 
• A proactive, customer-oriented, and communicative personality. 
 

In addition, you have a strong analytical mindset, enjoy working with data, and pay close attention to detail. This enables you to maintain an overview, meet deadlines, and handle confidential information with the utmost discretion.
